features.title: Mute or snooze a thread
features.summary: Mute a thread for 1 h, 8 h, 24 h, until tomorrow morning (09:00), a week, or until unmuted, from its row, its context menu or the session header. A muted thread raises no desktop alert, attention group, label or unread dot and keeps its place instead of rising on new activity; a bell-off marker's tooltip gives the time left, and it wakes on its own. Mutes are Host-synced sidebar settings; the Muted filter lists them.
reach: fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "Mute target"

configuration.constraints: Hidden; session id → { until: epoch ms or null for until unmuted, activityAt: the activity time the row keeps while muted }. Expired entries are dropped when they wake.

failureModes: Muting silences this sidebar only: the Host still records attention, and the thread's composer still shows a pending request.

features.title: See threads a crash interrupted

An older Host that answers with session ids only keeps working: the client treats those ids as managed restarts.

verification.reason: The state needs a Host that stopped mid-turn, which no UI step can produce: a browser journey would first need a new dshx dev seed that opens a turn, kills the scratch Host without the managed-restart handshake, and boots it again.

features.title: Open a thread in the right side panel
features.summary: A thread's row context menu, its hover action and the Open in side panel command palette action open that thread in the right sidebar instead of the main column: the row action routes through the entry's sidebar-right controller, which opens a threadaside resource tab. The tab retains the Session and hosts the same embedded Conversation a subagent chat does, so the thread streams and its composer works beside the thread the user is reading; closing the tab only releases the reference, and an already-open aside is focused instead of duplicated. The rebindable command threadSidebar.openInSidePanel ships unbound, and Customize sidebar > Hover actions stores hiddenRowActions so every row button is per-user.

configuration.constraints: Which hover buttons a row hides: none, or any combination of resume, resumeDismiss, aside, pin, park, mute, archive and restore. A missing id keeps its button.

failureModes: An aside tab closed while the thread is still running keeps running: nothing is archived.

features.title: See which threads reference one thread
features.summary: Both thread menus open a Referenced by submenu listing the threads that point back at one thread: its forked and subagent children from the Host session headers, plus the threads whose messages pulled it in as referenced context, found by one bounded session-content lookup for the thread id.
